title: Apex Legends ranked roadmap: Legend Ban in Diamond+ from Season 31 (November), Iron, Emerald and Grandmaster ranks and Open / Pro-Am leagues in Season 32 (early 2027)

claims.claim: Legend Ban in Diamond+ matches from Season 31, starting November
each player votes one Legend; ban chance by votes; random selection; not most-voted to avoid a ban meta
entry cost adjusted for squads 2+ tiers above/below lobby tier (Challenger/Goliath)
Road to Ranked removed; Account Level 20 only
Season 32 early 2027: Iron replaces Rookie, Emerald between Platinum and Diamond, Grandmaster at top; Open League and Pro-Am League
